carrier.outer_recipient: Exactly one canonical p tag matching the captured provider identity; optional relay hint and unrelated bounded tags remain permitted.
carrier.signed_reader: One shared exact bounded raw JSON reader verifies ID/signature before upstream conversion or private callbacks.
carrier.unsigned_reader: Closed borrowed object, raw u16 kind, canonical keys/ID, bounded protected decoded text/tags and original NIP01 identity recomputation.
carrier.encryption: NIP44 v2 bounded short-length profile; provider custody, MAC validation and per-call deadline/cancellation remain required. No extended multi-gigabyte profile is claimed.

admission: Admit original outer JSON, ID/signature, kind and actual recipient before provider callbacks.
Validate encryption framing and provider identity/support before decrypting the seal; recheck identity afterwards.
Admit raw seal ID/signature, kind13 and empty tags before decrypting the rumor; recheck identity afterwards.
Decode closed bounded rumor, recompute original identity and bind seal author to rumor author.
Retain authentic unsupported carrier kind before interpreting known commerce content.
Probe profile/version/type; retain authentic future content as unsupported rather than partial known data.
For known records verify complete closed data/hash, empty rumor tags, exact author/time/kind and actual recipient equal to buyer or seller.

retention.unsupported_and_rejected: Protected authenticated carrier evidence remains retained; no known record or business capability is minted.
retention.provider_failure: Returns a fixed source-redacted failure; original caller-owned encrypted outer remains available. No authenticated record is inferred.

limits.provider_qualification: A provider observation does not prove honest cryptography; each actual supported host provider requires execution qualification.
